law_name: Ordinance-Law No. 86-033 of 5 April 1986 on the Protection of Copyright and Neighbouring Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 74); photographs 25 years from first publication (Art. 77)
enforcement_body: SONECA - collective management body collecting and distributing royalties (Ministerial order 2007, based on arts. 68 and 111 of Ordonnance-loi 86-033)
notes: Law dates from 1986; implementing order 1994; no replacement found. Details from secondary summaries; WCT/WPPT status not checked.
